title: "Colab deployment packet"
description: "Colab's Worker, Durable Object identity, deploy path, rollback and smoke checks."
updatedAt: "2026-11-10"
audience: developers
---

Colab (`apps/colab`) is already a Cloudflare Worker with a Vite single-page
frontend. It has no Vercel deployment, so it does not take part in the
Vercel-exit cutovers. Its Worker entry is `src/server/worker.ts`; the frontend is
served from `dist` through the `ASSETS` binding.

## Identity that must not change

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Worker | `tuturuuu-colab` |
| Domain | `colab.tuturuuu.com` (custom domain) |
| Durable Object | binding `ROOMS`, class `ColabRoom`, SQLite migration tag `v1` |
| Other bindings | `ASSETS` |
| Variables | `APP_ORIGIN`, `AUTH_ORIGIN`, `COLAB_AI_MODEL` |
| Secret (name) | `COLAB_SESSION_SECRET` |
| Worker-first paths | `/`, `/join`, `/host`, `/guide`, `/workshops`, `/api/*`, `/auth/*`, `/verify-token` |

Inference is the AI Studio Gemini gateway, not a Worker binding. The bindings
that remain are `ASSETS` and the `ROOMS` Durable Object.

Renaming the class, changing the binding or rewriting the migration tag would
detach existing room state. Any change to the entry bundle needs the room,
WebSocket and expiry runtime checks in `apps/colab/scripts` to pass first.

## Deploy

`colab-cloudflare.yaml` validates on pull requests and `main`. Its `deploy` job
runs only for the `production` branch in the `colab-production` environment: it
runs `wrangler deploy` with the token secret `COLAB_CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`, then
`scripts/verify-deployment.mjs` compares the live entry shell, `/api/health` and
every built asset hash against the local build.

## Rollback

Roll back to the previous Worker version in Cloudflare, or redeploy the previous
production commit. Durable Object storage is not affected by a version rollback.

## Smoke checks

- `GET https://colab.tuturuuu.com/api/health` answers `200` with
  `app: "colab"` and `status: "ok"`
- `GET /` and `/guide` answer `200`
- after a deploy, `node apps/colab/scripts/verify-deployment.mjs` from a built
  checkout reports the asset hashes verified
